text:
maria.lee: FYI — SilverBrim interview landed. Customer agreed to a 30m video + 1 follow-up quote. Need ops + legal checklist. :tada:
ajohnson: awesome! can we lock a date this week? timezone: PST for their PM.
sanjay.p: I can do Wed 10am PT or Thu 11am PT. which works for their comms lead?
emily_w: looping @maria.lee — SilverBrim PR prefers Thu. they asked for a short Q&A doc beforehand.
maria.lee: cool. can someone draft the Qs and send for review? short, product + outcome focused.
ajohnson: i'll draft. aim for 8–10 questions, plus 3 'pull-quote' prompts. sending draft by EOD. :pencil2:
sanjay.p: legal check needed for quote usage and embargo window. tagging legal-team for visibility.
legal-team: thanks — please include the draft quote lines. we typically ask for a signature on the quote release form; 72h turnaround target.
emily_w: note: we want to feature a benchmark callout (latency improvement) in the case study. need a numeric quote verifying the metric. can we ask SilverBrim for the specific test/job id?
maria.lee: yes — ask them for the benchmark run id + approximate baseline numbers. add to Qs: "Which job/config did you measure? Can you confirm the 3.2x latency reduction stat?"
ajohnson: draft Qs below (sending):

```
1) Brief intro to your role and SilverBrim's use of Redwood Inference
2) Which workload did you benchmark (model + sequence length)? please include job/run id
3) What was baseline latency and the improved latency after moving to Redwood?
4) Any implementation changes or config that mattered (batching, cache)?
5) Top 1–2 business outcomes you saw (eng productivity, cost, user metrics)
6) Can we publish a short quote verifying the 3.2x latency improvement? please attach a signoff name/email.
7) Any people we should credit (title + name) and headshot permission?
8) Are there any legal or compliance constraints on the asset? embargo window?
```

ajohnson: also added: "Please review and sign the quote release form attached after the call."
sanjay.p: ops-bot will create the calendar when you confirm time. include dial-in + recording off by default.
ops-bot: (automated) calendar created: Thu 2026-04-15 11:00 PT — invite pending acceptance. Recording link will be posted after consent.
emily_w: localization: we need a single-sentence TL;DR for EU audiences and a localized headline. @maria.lee can you add to the brief?
maria.lee: added TL;DR + headline suggestions to the doc. also requested a short 1-sentence case quote in French (they have EU ops).
legal-team: quick reminder — for any numeric claims tied to benchmarks, we need the underlying test artifacts (config, seed, script) or a signed attestation from SilverBrim. please flag if they can't provide artifacts.
ajohnson: will ask them for either run id + config or an attestation form. if we only get attestation we'll include a note "based on customer-reported benchmark".
emily_w: webinar ask: can SilverBrim be on a 20m panel during launch week? if yes, ask for a C-level or engineering speaker and a 5-slide summary.
sanjay.p: pinging SilverBrim contact in reply thread now. short — confirm Thu 11am PT and webinar speaker availability.
maria.lee: perfect. once we have signed quote release + either artifacts or attestation, i'll route to design for page + 2 social cards.
ajohnson: timeline check — interview Thu, quote release by Mon (72h), legal signoff Mon evening, design ready Tue, publish and webinar the following Thurs? looks ok but tight.
emily_w: agree. set embargo date in doc to avoid accidental leaks.
legal-team: we'll prep a lightweight quote release template and upload to the thread after the call.
maria.lee: thanks team. i'll post the finalized invite + draft Qs here once SilverBrim confirms. :sparkles:
ajohnson: one last thing — routing: please mark incoming leads from SilverBrim case page to AE team A (ae-east) and select "enterprise" priority. i'll update routing rule after publish.
emily_w: noted. i'll add routing note to the playbook.
maria.lee: thread done for now, will update with confirmations. :handshake:
